name: Cottonwood dagger moth
desc: Cottonwood dagger moth (Acronicta lepusculina): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Acronicta lepusculina, commonly known as the cottonwood dagger moth, is a species of moth in the family Noctuidae. The species was first described by Achille Guenée in 1852.
